source: Actual MCP calls against a running packaged desktop app; the recorded page is a fictional demo fixture.
prompt: This is an explicitly authorized product demo and real MCP client acceptance test on ONLY the clean fictional project c8cfa244-89ea-43e4-9b3e-cbeeda732020 named "A better product walkthrough". It contains a 12-second fictional Fieldnotes window recording and no personal content. Use only screen-recorder MCP tools. Do not use built-in tools, access files or other projects, record, or call preview_load/preview_play. 1. Call project_open for this exact ID to get latest revision. 2. Call timeline_apply once with that revision, requestId "launch-codex-demo-edit-20260913", operations: [{"type":"zoom.add","zoom":{"startMs":2000,"endMs":5500,"scale":1.6,"x":0.32,"y":0.35,"followCursor":false,"motion":"gentle"}},{"type":"overlay.add","overlay":{"kind":"text","text":"A little focus goes a long way.","startMs":6500,"endMs":11000,"x":0.1,"y":0.80,"width":0.8,"fontSize":40,"color":"#d8ed96","animation":"fade"}}]. 3. Call preview_frame for the same project at timeMs 3500. 4. Call export_start for the same project with quality "1080", requestId "launch-codex-demo-export-20260913", path "[new MP4 export destination]". 5. Poll only the returned job using jobs_get until completed, failed, or cancelled. Report actual project revision, preview image result and final export status. Do not change the project further. On errors report exact error and stop; do not invent success.
